title: Vineyard Poker Championships
seo_title: Vineyard Poker Championships in Ozark, MO
description: The Vineyard Poker Championships is a poker tournament where players compete for the championship title, with fine cigars and friendly rivalry along the way. It is invite-only, for players who earned a seat through previous Vineyard poker nights, with a $50 buy-in; reserve by calling (417) 882-0399 or online. It takes place Tuesday, December 8, 2026 at 6:00 PM at Vineyard Market, 1759 W State Hwy J, Ozark, MO.
